name: Nomination Created — Trigger ETA Analysis
description: Triggered when OGS/650 posts a new nomination creation event via webhook. Stores the nomination in the CAP service, invokes the ETA Orchestrator Agent (which in turn calls all three specialist agents — Historical, AIS, Geo/Weather — to produce a live weighted ETA proposal), stores the resulting proposal in CAP for supervisor review in the Approval Queue, and responds to OGS/650 confirming the analysis has been triggered. Implements REQ-01 (automatic ETA proposal on nomination creation) and M1 (nomination detected).
